description: Prints a day name from a menu number using a switch statement, which the subset does not support.
notes: Expected under plan 004: raw 8. SYN-UNSUPPORTED-FEATURE 6 (caused_by: none), SYN-UNSUPPORTED-FEATURE 7 (caused_by: R2), SYN-UNSUPPORTED-FEATURE 10 (caused_by: R9), SYN-UNSUPPORTED-FEATURE 13 (caused_by: R9), SYN-UNSUPPORTED-FEATURE 16 (caused_by: R9), SEM-BREAK-OUTSIDE-LOOP 9 (caused_by: R7), SEM-BREAK-OUTSIDE-LOOP 12 (caused_by: R7), SEM-BREAK-OUTSIDE-LOOP 15 (caused_by: R7). Displayed 1. Panic after 'switch' stops before '{' (orphan block, ErrorStmt kind_hint unsupported). 'case 1' is reached while that region is open, so R2 links it; its panic consumes a ';', closing the region. 'case 2', 'case 3' and 'default' are then linked by R9 (innermost block is an orphan of the unsupported ErrorStmt). The three 'break;' statements are in that orphan block with no real loop between, so R7 links them. Assumes case/default are UNSUPPORTED_KEYWORDs (language-spec section 1). gcc accepts the file, so gcc_rejects is false.
